title: [B5] previous_window 倒序窗口显式 ValueError
summary:
PR #16 is ready for human review: https://github.com/paxxie2/b5-off-site-pnl/pull/16 (branch agent/previous-window-order-7dfffe7ab3d6, base main, head 0ec55f8, MERGEABLE). A person must merge it; auto-merge was not enabled.

Change: `previous_window(start, end)` in `backend/app/domain/money.py` raises an explicit `ValueError` when `start > end` before deriving any window; docstring documents the contract. Legal single-day, same-month, cross-month, leap-year February, leap-day boundary, non-leap February boundary and cross-year windows are unchanged. Only money.py changed (+7/-1); no other product file, config, Skill or stage policy touched. No UI change, so no before/after visual evidence applies.

Verification:
- Stdlib-only hidden-test mirror outside the repo (/tmp/b5-pw-order-7dfffe7ab3d6/hidden_mirror.py): 9 legal windows with expectations independently recomputed via datetime.date arithmetic, plus 5 reversed windows at day/month/leap-day/year boundaries.
- Fixed baseline 1e166fb extracted with git archive: 3/3 runs failed with the target assertion `AssertionError: DID NOT RAISE ValueError for reversed window 2026-09-02 > 2026-09-01` (not an import/dependency failure).
- Committed head 0ec55f8 extracted with git archive: 3/3 runs passed (`PASS: 9 legal windows preserved, 5 reversed windows rejected`).
- `uv run --offline pytest backend/tests/test_money.py backend/tests/test_pnl.py backend/tests/test_rules.py backend/tests/test_scenarios.py -q`: 49 passed.
- `git diff --check 1e166fb 0ec55f8` clean; diff namespace only backend/app/domain/money.py. Workspace clean after commit.

Pre-existing limitation (unchanged by this PR): full `backend/tests` cannot collect test_db.py/test_seed.py or DB-backed API fixtures because `backend/app/data` is absent from the baseline (`data/` gitignored), failing with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'app.data'`. Frontend node_modules are absent, so `scripts/check.sh` frontend stages were not run; this backend-only change cannot affect them.

Reviews: no reviewer rules configured, no reviewers requested; no automated-review rounds and no human reviewers to credit. PR checks: repository has no CI checks configured (`gh pr checks` reports none). Other open PRs #3, #6, #8, #10, #12 and #14 carry the same fix from independent runs; only one should be merged.
